⚠️ [Alpha Release]
This game is still under heavy development.

Delve is a mining RPG about mining through various areas and getting stronger. Mine rare ores, forge and upgrade your gear, try and obtain the rarest forsaken drops, while fighting your way through monsters and bosses. When you are ready, enter the Delve, an endless roguelike dungeon diver of caves that collapses behind you.

How far can you go?

- Q / Space to Dash
- T to Open Inventory
- B to Open Shop
- H to Hide Helmet
